title: Fonts
slide_intent: Choose a consistent typographic voice because recurring letterforms make unrelated messages feel like one speaker.
strategic_value: Helsinki Grotesk and the stated workstation alternative can keep city communications recognizable across production environments.
demonstration: This webpage introduction names the custom paid Helsinki Grotesk face, Pro from 2025, and Arial as an alternative, then states an introductory restriction on other fonts and handwritten-text-like illustrations.
practical_value: Use the named faces while consulting the detailed language exceptions before applying the introductory restriction.

content_islands.name: Font introduction
content_islands.spec: Keep the custom-face description, Arial alternative and restriction beneath the Fonts heading.

ingredient.name: Helsinki typefaces
ingredient.role: Give city messages a consistent typographic voice.
ingredient.application: Use Helsinki Grotesk Pro or the stated Arial alternative; read the language-specific instructions for unsupported writing systems.
ingredient.scope: This introduction is not a complete language policy: the detailed section assigns Arial for Arabic and Noto Sans for other unsupported languages.

reference_purposes.Application: The text assigns Helsinki Grotesk and Arial as the principal production choices.
